body: Coordinator trap (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-28 09:33Z, my own slip). Running "$TERMAL_CLI" with NO arguments, or with an unknown first argument such as help or --help, does not print usage. With no arguments it tries to START A SECOND TermAl SERVER on ~/.termal. It refused safely: the data-directory lock was held by the running host (pid 59120), and it "stopped before loading, recovering or persisting any state". Never invoke TERMAL_CLI bare. Use only the documented subcommands (mailbox read | send | acknowledge | list). There is no CLI or MCP route for an agent to resume a ROOT session's paused queue; termal_resume_session only resumes held DELEGATIONS. A provider-parked root session such as Merger2 is resumed by Greg in the TermAl UI.
